rows.title: Bootcamp in the River Park with GymParty
rows.location: Arena Green West, N Autumn St, San Jose, CA 95113, USA
rows.description: We are partnering with @gymparty_ to bring the finest instructors to Bootcamp in the River Park. 💯 Bootcamp workout classes are fast-paced, full-body group sessions mixing cardio and strength training into one efficient workout. The classes are designed for all levels! Our first program launches AUGUST 6, 2026 2026 Dates are as follows: 8/6, 8/20, 9/3, 9/17, 10/1, 10/15, 11/5, 11/19

rows.title: Neighborhood Hands Bi-monthly Cleanup
rows.description: Our pilot program meets every other Saturday at 7:45 A.M. in Guadalupe Gardens just north of the Spring St. cul de sac off Coleman Avenue across from Target. (Google Maps directions here; see red pin on map below.) If the weather is good, we clean the park until approximately 9:15 A.M., unhoused neighbors receive stipends, then everyone enjoys a vibrant and growing community resource fair until ~10:30 A.M.
